story: Omar and Nina go to the bookstore. They see many young people there. A photo of a horse is on a table. They feel hungry and walk away from the store. Nina cooks in the dining-room. She puts an orange over the plate and answers her phone.
title: A Trip to the Bookstore
setting: A bookstore and a dining room.

characters.name: Omar
characters.look: a young man with short black hair and a blue shirt

characters.name: Nina
characters.look: a young woman with long brown hair and a yellow dress

sentences.en: Omar and Nina go to the bookstore.
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar, a young man with short black hair and a blue shirt, and Nina, a young woman with long brown hair and a yellow dress, walk toward a bookstore.

sentences.en: They see many young people there.
sentences.zh: 他们在那里看到许多年轻人。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar and Nina stand inside the bookstore looking at many young people.

sentences.en: A photo of a horse is there.
sentences.scene_prompt: A photo of a large brown horse sits on a bookstore table.

sentences.en: They feel hungry two hours ago.
sentences.zh: 他们在两小时前感到饥饿。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar and Nina look at each other with hungry expressions.

sentences.en: They walk away from the bookstore.
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar and Nina walk away from the bookstore entrance.

sentences.en: Nina cooks in the large dining-room.
sentences.zh: 妮娜在宽敞的餐厅里烹饪。
sentences.scene_prompt: Nina is in a dining-room with a pot on the stove.

sentences.en: She puts an orange over the plate.
sentences.zh: 她把一个橙子放在盘子上方。
sentences.scene_prompt: Nina holds an orange over a white plate in the dining-room.

sentences.en: She answers a call near the food.
sentences.zh: 她在食物附近接听电话。
sentences.scene_prompt: Nina holds a phone to her ear while standing in the dining-room.
